context: A doctor discusses a complex case
purpose: Teach: 過失/匹敵/八木/出血/究明/受診/遮断/一刻

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者さん、過失による事故で、運ばれてこられました。
lines.en: Ren — the patient came in with injuries from a negligence-related accident.
lines.style: Direct medical briefing. Steady, unhurried pace. Clinical tone without coldness. Protective distance maintained — the facts first, the human layer underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 症例、過去の大事故に、匹敵するレベルですね。
lines.en: The severity matches what we'd see in major trauma cases from the past.
lines.style: Thoughtful intake of breath. Leaning into genuine intellectual interest. Not performing curiosity — actually tracking the complexity. Slight pause before the comparison lands.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。八木先生、麻酔のスペシャリストとして、対応しております。
lines.en: Yes. Yagi-sensei is managing the case in her capacity as an anesthesia specialist.
lines.style: Confirmation with quiet authority. Even tone — naming expertise without fanfare. The patience of someone who's explained this many times and will explain it again.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 術中、出血コントロール、難しいケースだったんですね。
lines.en: Bleeding control during surgery — it was a difficult case to manage.
lines.style: Slower, more careful. Not quite a question, but open-ended. The weight of 'difficult' settles. Recognition without complaint. Soft tone, like turning something over in your hands.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。原因究明のため、検査、複数回、実施しました。
lines.en: Yes. We ran multiple diagnostic rounds to determine the underlying cause.
lines.style: Procedural certainty. Even pace, no rushing. The competence of someone who followed protocol without shortcuts. Slight emphasis on 'multiple' — not guessing, investigating.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 初期段階で、受診されていれば、もっと、軽症だったかもしれませんね。
lines.en: If he'd presented earlier, at the initial stage, the injury might have been less severe.
lines.style: Gentle conditional. Not accusatory — observational. The 'if' is soft, the 'might have been' trails slightly. Clinical regret without blame.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。出血を、薬で、遮断する技術、進歩していますね。
lines.en: Yes. The pharmaceutical techniques for controlling hemorrhage have come a long way.
lines.style: Quiet note of qualified hope. Measured but genuine — not sales pitch, but acknowledgment of real progress. The tone of someone who sees both what's still hard and what's getting better.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 一刻を争う場面、医療現場、緊張感、すごいですよね。
lines.en: When every second counts — the intensity in the medical setting, it's something else entirely.
lines.style: Final observation, almost to himself. Awe without dramatizing. Soft landing — the recognition that he's witnessed something he didn't expect to feel. Trailing off with genuine respect.
